verdict.rationale: GitLab CI/CD is referenced generally (build/test docs, CI worker deploy mentions) but the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of deployment-specific features like environments, auto-deploy, deployment strategies, or rollback. Community evidence (gitlab-comm-1) even mentions CI workers failing to run deployments, indicating reliability concerns rather than confirming a robust deployment pipeline. missing for 10: explicit docs on environments/auto-deploy, deployment strategies (canary, blue-green), rollback support, and independent corroboration of successful deployment automation.
